mod36_metric_null_playoff_leverage_ats_p.classification_evidence: Negative-control null distribution of a term with no game link; it is an instrument reading, closes nothing and is no closing ground.
mod36_metric_null_playoff_leverage_ats_p.description: Matched-marginal null: the real levdiff column shuffled among games within each season, 200 draws (seed 36), entered as an intercept and one coefficient on the served out-of-season logit, leave-one-season-out 2020-2025, versus an intercept-only fit; graded on ats_points (picked-side margin against the opener, or whole-margin ranked probability score of the discrete line-conditional lattice tilted to the cover probability); effect is the mean of draws, interval the 5th to 95th percentile, probability_positive the share of draws above zero.
mod36_metric_null_playoff_leverage_ats_p.notes: Family mod36_metric_power: 4 templates x 2 margin metrics; accuracy, log loss and Brier nulls are the identical draws already recorded under mod36_addone_noise_floor; planted-effect cells and detection shares stay in the lane.
mod36_metric_null_playoff_leverage_ats_p.plain_summary: A check that scrambles the gap in playoff stakes between the two teams in late-season games, to show how much a meaningless extra ingredient moves the average winning margin against the opening line of the side picked.
